title: Cosima potato: Characteristics
metaDescription: Cosima potato is a potato variety from introduced variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Cosima is a registered potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1978. It comes from introduced variety.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Cosima potato is grown

blocks.text: Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: Registered in 1978 with the Philippine Seed Board.
Production limited by lack of seed tubers.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: among the five potatoes Benguet farmers like best, but scarce because planting material is hard to find. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Cosima potato

Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Cosima?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
